column1: # Guicciardini's cipher, ca.1590 (secretary of the Grand Duke of Tuscany; found among diplomatic correspondence addressed to Henri IV, 1590) -- Tomokiyo's rearrangement of the table in Monts de Savasse (1997), 'Les chiffres de la correspondance diplomatique des ambassadeurs d'Henri IV, en l'annee 1590', 120e Congres CTHS, pp.219-228.
# Credit: table Monts de Savasse 1997; grid arrangement S. Tomokiyo, Cryptiana (cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/guicciardini.htm). Rule 8: cited, transcribed for screening only.

# Grid: row '-' = single-figure codes 1-9; row r, column c = two-figure code rc (row 0 -> 01..09). Polyphonic: a cell with several meanings is written a|b|c (the published comma list, order kept); '1|6 er.re' kept as printed ('er.re').
# Transcription TUSC-KEYS (14 Oct 2026, account 2): two blind Sonnet passes (row-wise and column-wise) agree on all 84 cells; my own read agrees. Grade H-published = printed in the published table.

# Empty cells (no meaning printed): 0, 00, 17, 20, 21, 22, 25, 30, 50, 52, 57, 60, 68, 70, 71, 73, 74, 75, 77, 79, 85, 87, 90, 92, 97, 98. Tomokiyo: 'more irregular' and polyphonic; no regularity found in the arrangement.
# office: Grand Duke of Tuscany's secretariat (Guicciardini, probably the same secretary)
# key_source: published (Monts de Savasse 1997; grid arrangement S. Tomokiyo, Cryptiana guicciardini.htm)
# home: none (screening table for ciphers/fr3982-nevers-toscana-1592; kept here so that folder's own keys keep their office metadata)
